parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search. The search uses the %Keyword% pattern and is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value starts from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp.
